purpose: Prospectively test a previously discovery-generated broad functional module K contrast in genuinely independent primary plant measurements; never label AusTraits discovery itself as prospective.

discovery_provenance.discovery_34_families: 313/406 S3 and 314/397 prune reproductive > vegetative, 34 original AusTraits families
challenge_sources: AusTraits Kew_2019_1 partially derived from Kew Seed Information Database
Tng_2013 potentially shared historical study with TRY DatasetID 625

frozen_biological_classes.seed_height_excluded: Fails original K-blind source calibration coverage; is not resurrected to improve results.

frozen_all_discovery_42_family_logistic.method: scikit-learn LogisticRegression C=1, no intercept, lbfgs; predictor +1 if A reproductive, B vegetative; -1 vice versa; 0 same class; trained on original matched-tip 760/747 family×trait pairs after K outcomes were seen.

eligibility_gates_to_be_resolved_before_.source_independence: Audit dataset release, raw measurement lineage, original specimen/observation IDs where available and original primary citation/source DOI, excluding any observations derived from original AusTraits contributing raw records, Kew SID or Tng study where primary record overlap cannot be distinguished. Unknown independence=HOLD, not PASS.
eligibility_gates_to_be_resolved_before_.source_access: Use data only under provider's valid license/registration/permissions; do not scrape restricted TRY records or redistribute original measurements.
eligibility_gates_to_be_resolved_before_.trait_semantics: Fix projected leaf versus leaflet, petiole inclusion, fruit versus infructescence, seed versus diaspore mass, and dry versus assumed dry seed mass definitions. Exclude incompatible concept measurements before K outputs.
eligibility_gates_to_be_resolved_before_.pair_definition: One family×one reproductive trait×one vegetative trait from exactly the same originally source-qualified species on exactly the same tree. Families count once regardless of number of trait pairs.

post_qualification_external_estimands.primary: Within each of >=12 fully qualified independent families, fraction of reproductive-versus-vegetative same-tip comparisons with K_reproductive>K_vegetative; equally weight families (not dependent trait-pair rows). Report both S3 and prune with 5,000 family bootstrap replicates.
secondary: Pair-weighted organ direction and support coverage, with family-bootstrap interval
Brier skill of the locked discovery-trained organ-only probability versus the locked global baseline as independently estimated from the discovery cohort; report both tree axes
Leave-one-organ-member-out trait sensitivity and fruit-only versus vegetative and seed-only versus vegetative
Source- and protocol-specific measurement error/covariance model fitted without using the discovery K outcomes
Pre-specified original source lineage-based exclusions and missingness reporting
post_qualification_external_estimands.provisional_positive_decision: Only if >=12 independent qualifying families including both fruit and seed comparisons meet gates and the family-bootstrap 95% lower bound of reproductive-higher rate exceeds 0.5 on BOTH tree axes; treat failed support as UNTESTED not evidence for biological equality.
post_qualification_external_estimands.negative_decision: If gates pass but the lower bound fails on either axis, do not claim independent confirmed reproductive-vegetative K ordering.
post_qualification_external_estimands.source_noise_process_requirement: Any mechanistic process conclusion requires a new source-specific joint trait-covariance and measurement-error-aware evolutionary null, not merely sign direction.

hard_nonclaims: This is a prospective-on-NEW-DATA replication plan for a hypothesis generated after seeing all original AusTraits K and shared-tip outcomes; no original finding is relabelled preregistered.
Current TRY version 7 record-level source identity/permissions remain unverified; a database name or newer release is not independent primary measurement proof.
A cross-organ K advantage is not an evolutionary rate difference or evidence of selection, stabilizing selection or developmental canalization.
Do not reopen the scientifically closed BIEN 201-system rho analysis or change its unrelated frozen outcome adjudication.
If independent primary measurements with correct family/trait/tip support cannot be obtained, record external validation HOLD without changing thresholds.
